summary: Tiimo timestamps carry no offset and must be parsed in the local zone, matching the zone window bounds are built in.
reason: time.Parse tags them UTC while windows use time.Local, skewing every comparison off-UTC. Combined with Tiimo storing bucket-scheduled activities at T00:00:00, that made today and gaps return nothing on a day with fourteen activities.
validated_outcome: today went from 0 to 14 entries on a UTC-5 machine.
